shadows.purpose: Hover state on clickable cards and media tiles, paired with a 2px upward translate.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus, the account menu, and the add-user dialog.

motion.name: tile-morph
motion.purpose: Shared-element morph from a post or story tile into its detail hero, via React <ViewTransition share="morph">. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The system curve for movement: card lift, floating-layer entrances, the tile morph. Exposed as the Tailwind utility ease-out-expo.

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: Hover lift on clickable cards and tiles; :active settles flat. No translate under reduced motion.

motion.name: float-enter
motion.value: 150ms (menus) / 200ms (dialog) ease-out-expo from scale 0.95 and opacity 0 via @starting-style
motion.purpose: Dropdowns, the account menu and the add-user dialog. Dialog exits in 150ms. Reduced motion keeps the fade only.

components.css: .ds-history-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 14px/20px var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-history-label { width: 96px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-history-from { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-history-arrow { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-history-to { color: var(--foreground); font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-delta { padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-geist-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-delta-gain { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 10%, transparent); color: var(--success); } .ds-delta-loss { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a calm, gray room built so the archived photos and stories are the only real color on the page. Surfaces are near-white zinc in light mode and near-black zinc in dark mode, separated by one-pixel hairlines rather than shadows. A single indigo accent marks what you can act on. Everything else is ink and quiet gray.

It is deliberately familiar. A sticky top bar, media grids, search fields and dropdowns all behave the way visitors expect from social apps, so nobody has to learn the layout before finding the person they came for. Density is high: most text is 14px, gaps run 8 to 16px, and grids go up to five columns wide on desktop.

Precision carries the personality. Counts use tabular figures, dates are exact, and profile history renders as literal before and after values with an arrow between them. The UI keeps its own voice low so these facts read clearly.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutrals with one indigo accent; media supplies the color.
Flat bordered surfaces that lift slightly only on hover.
Geist Sans throughout, mostly at 14px, semibold for headings.
44px minimum touch targets on every control.
Full light and dark themes defined from the same token names.

rules.name: The Media Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays zinc and indigo. Photos, stories and avatars are the only full-color content, and the UI never competes with them through tinted panels or gradients.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Archive Indigo is the only hue that signals interaction. Don't introduce a second accent; red and green are reserved for loss and gain.

rules.name: The Tabular Facts Rule
rules.body: Every count, delta and statistic uses tabular figures (`tabular-nums`) so columns of numbers line up and changes are easy to compare.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. If a surface needs separation, use a Hairline border or a step between Page Mist and Card White.

dos: Do use the semantic tokens (`bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `bg-accent`) and never raw zinc or indigo classes, so both themes stay correct.
Do keep every interactive control at least 44px tall (`min-h-11`).
Do check every text and badge pair at 4.5:1 and every field edge at 3:1, in both themes, including text on the Well fill.
Do put any text over media on the 60% black gradient scrim, in white.
Do use `tabular-nums` for every count, delta and statistic.
Do use the shared grid column presets in `components/ui/grid-columns.ts` for any new media grid, so skeletons and virtualization match.

Do name transition properties (`transition-[translate,box-shadow]`, `transition-colors`) instead of `transition-all`, use the `ease-out-expo` curve for movement, and give every movement a `motion-reduce:` fallback.
donts: Don't add shadows to surfaces at rest; shadows mean hover or floating.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or use Archive Indigo decoratively; it signals interaction or verification only.
Don't use Gain Green or Loss Red outside gains, losses and errors.
Don't add new corner radii beyond 6px, 8px, 12px and full.
Don't tint or color-grade archived media. The black text scrim is the only overlay it gets.
